_note: Scripted paths for the sample triggers in config/trigger-samples.json, used only when MODEL_PROVIDER=stub. One script per severity band, plus per-sample overrides for sentences that exercise something their band does not. `bands` is matched on the sample's expected tier; `samples` wins when a key matches the sample id. config/stub-script.json is untouched and is still the default take (the clock-driven medication refill).
_limits: A static script cannot quote words it has not seen, so these do not call record_account: the transcript has to be verbatim (R5) and only a real model has the sentence in front of it. They also avoid naming a provider, because provider names live in onboarding data that is all placeholder today. What these scripts do demonstrate is the routing the severity decides: critical acts and settles up afterwards, urgent and routine stop and ask the RP first. A static script also cannot branch on an answer: test_due_tap always closes on the second clinic, whichever of the three buttons is pressed. A real model reads the answer and does what was actually chosen -- including the decline path, where it tells the family and escalates to the RP.
_r19: Every turn that calls a tool opens with log_decision. There is no exemption, not even for set_stage.
